clips.title: The story
paras: Valstag Ironjaw is an Ironforge dwarven soldier stationed within Menethil Keep in the coastal marshlands of the Wetlands. Facing the pressing dangers that plague the trade passages connecting Loch Modan and the coast, he assists in securing regional routes and keeping the harbor's garrison informed of local threats.

Found inside Menethil Keep in Menethil Harbor, Valstag Ironjaw serves as part of the dwarven garrison keeping watch over the lowlands. The surrounding marsh is rife with danger, from hostile Dragonmaw orcs to ravenous wildlife, making communications and supply lines difficult to maintain. Valstag helps coordinate defense efforts along the primary thoroughfares, particularly the treacherous passage cutting through Dun Algaz toward Loch Modan.

With the treacherous Algaz Gauntlet choked by hostile forces, travelers and supply convoys heading between Menethil Harbor and Loch Modan are under constant threat. Valstag directs capable adventurers to confront the brigands and orcs lurking in the passes, relaying crucial military intelligence back and forth between forward scouts and commanders like Captain Stoutfist.
